sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Reset with ACTION7
result = action(['ACTION7'])
seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'c':
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"After ACTION7: dark gray pixels={n['pixels']} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check yellow position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 72:
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  yellow: cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Check divider position
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] == 'S':
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        print(f"  divider: cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Now try RIGHT to move left panel right
print("\nTrying RIGHT:")
for i in range(10):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'c':
            b = n['boundary']
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            print(f"  RIGHT {i+1}: dark gray pixels={n['pixels']} cols={min(cols)}-{max(cols)} level_done={result.get('level_completed')}")
            if result.get('level_completed'):
                break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
